You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6 of 6 planned. Sets: 84 (last week 84).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 176.4 lb x 8 (last week 170.9 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 220.5 lb x 6 (last week 215 lb x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 154.3 lb x 8 (last week 148.8 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- Romanian Deadlift: 198.4 lb x 8 (last week 192.9 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- Overhead Press: 99.2 lb x 8 (last week 93.7 lb x 8), estimated 1RM up 5.9%, 8 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 176.4 lb x 8; Barbell Back Squat 220.5 lb x 6; Barbell Row 154.3 lb x 8; Romanian Deadlift 198.4 lb x 8; Overhead Press 99.2 lb x 8.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 18 (last week 18), Back 23 (above the range; last week 23), Front delts 15 (last week 15), Side delts 10 (last week 10), Rear delts 10 (last week 10), Quads 14 (last week 14), Hamstrings 12 (last week 12), Glutes 22 (above the range; last week 22), Biceps 13 (last week 13), Triceps 15 (last week 15), Calves 2 (last week 2).
Cardio this week (the app shows it as a fact; give no advice on how much cardio to do): 100 min on 4 days: Treadmill 80 min, 8.28 mi; Stationary Bike 20 min. Last week: 100 min.
No body weight logged.
Weights are in lb; write every weight in lb.
The user's goal: "Build muscle".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
No rules fired this period.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: leave it empty: nothing fired, so give no advice.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
